name: Swetrix
description: Swetrix is a privacy-first, cookie-less web analytics platform with built-in error tracking and performance monitoring. Self-hosted via nginx reverse proxy with Node.js API and React frontend, backed by ClickHouse and Redis.

notes.text: Access Swetrix in your browser at http://<container-ip>. The first run launches the onboarding flow where you create your account.
Registration is disabled by default (DISABLE_REGISTRATION=true in /opt/swetrix/backend/.env). Set it to false to allow additional account creation.
Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse. Back up /var/lib/clickhouse before major updates.
